en: Stored charge. It does not deal damage or decay until a card Overloads or removes it.
zh: 储存在目标身上的电荷。不会自动造成伤害或衰减，直到卡牌触发过载或将其移除。

en: Take damage equal to stacks at the start of your turn. Then stacks are halved (rounded down).
zh: 每回合开始时受到等同层数的伤害。然后层数减半（向下取整）。

en: Outgoing attack damage reduced 50%. Additional stacks extend duration. Decays 1 per turn.
zh: 造成的攻击伤害降低 50%。额外层数只延长持续时间。每回合衰减 1 层。

en: Incoming attack damage increased 50% per stack. Decays 1 per turn.
zh: 每层使受到的攻击伤害提高 50%。每回合衰减 1 层。

en: Enemy skips its next turn for each stack (enemy-only).
zh: 每层使敌人跳过其下一回合（仅敌人）。

en: Heal stacks HP at the start of your turn. Stacks decay by 1 each turn.
zh: 每回合开始时回复等同层数的生命值。每回合衰减 1 层。

en: When hit by an attack, the attacker takes stacks damage. Loses 1 stack each time it triggers.
zh: 被攻击命中时，攻击者受到等同层数的伤害。每次触发时减少 1 层。
每次暴击时获得 2 层上膛。

en: Crits deal double damage. Non-Crit attacks deal normal damage and grant 2 Loaded.
zh: 暴击造成双倍伤害；未暴击的攻击正常造成伤害，并获得 2 层上膛。

en: Your next Attack is guaranteed to Crit, then remove 1 stack.
zh: 你的下一张攻击牌必定暴击，然后移除 1 层。
每次装弹时获得 3 点格挡。

en: Whenever a card grants Block, gain Thorns equal to stacks.
zh: 每当一张牌给予你格挡，获得等同于层数的荆棘。

en: The next Attack that deals damage gains stacks additional damage, then remove all stacks.
zh: 下一次造成伤害的攻击获得等同于层数的额外伤害，然后移除全部层数。

en: Attack ammo. 1 at the start of each turn; spent by attacking, restored by Reload.
zh: 攻击弹药。每回合开始 1 发；攻击消耗，装弹恢复。

en: Block gained is reduced 25%. Decays 1 per turn.
zh: 获得的格挡降低 25%。每回合衰减 1 层。

en: Completely negates incoming attacks, one stack consumed per attack.
zh: 完全抵消受到的攻击，每次攻击消耗一层。
攻击 — 造成 {n} 点伤害
攻击 — 造成 {n} 点伤害并施加 {status} {k}
防御 — 获得 {n} 点格挡

en: Breakable Armor — gains {n} Block; breaking it applies {status} {k} to this enemy
zh: 可破装甲 — 获得 {n} 点格挡；击破后该敌人获得 {status} {k}

en: Reflective Plating — gains {n} Block and {k} Thorns
zh: 反射镀层 — 获得 {n} 点格挡与 {k} 层荆棘
治疗 — 回复 {n} 点生命
增益 — 正在强化自身
反射镀层：+{block} 格挡 / +{thorns} 荆棘

en: At the start of your turn gain Block equal to stacks. Persistent.
zh: 每回合开始获得等同层数的格挡。持续。

en: Whenever a card is Exhausted gain Block equal to stacks. Persistent.
zh: 每当一张牌被消耗时获得等同层数的格挡。持续。
